input: Create a vision board for this year's goals

gold.taskTitle: Create a Vision Board for This Year's Goals
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to build a vision board to visually represent and manifest their goals for the current year.

questions.title: Will this be physical or digital?
questions.description: Determine whether the user wants a physical board (poster, corkboard) or a digital one (Canva, Pinterest, app).

questions.title: What life areas are the goals focused on?
questions.description: Identify which domains matter most — career, health, relationships, finances, travel, personal growth, etc.

questions.title: How many distinct goals will it represent?
questions.description: Understand the scope — a few focused goals or a broad collection covering many aspirations.

questions.title: Do you have images and materials ready already?
questions.description: Find out if the user needs to source photos, magazines, quotes, or digital assets, or if they already have them.

questions.title: Where will you display or use this board?
questions.description: Clarify the intended placement — bedroom wall, desktop wallpaper, journal insert — to guide size and format decisions.

questions.title: What is your deadline for finishing it?
questions.description: Establish a target completion date so the plan can be scoped and paced appropriately.

questions.title: Have you made a vision board before?
questions.description: Gauge the user's experience level to tailor guidance — beginner walkthroughs vs. refined techniques for veterans.
